title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 default in Claude Code + mods (v2.1.284–287) and Sonnet 4.5 retirement 30 Nov
bullets.summary: Anthropic made Sonnet 5.5 (30%+ faster, up to 30% cheaper than Sonnet 5) the Claude Code default, shipped TypeScript 'mods' for deeper behavior customization, and set Sonnet 4.5 to retire on 30 Nov 2026.
bullets.how: The Construct: audit scheduled routines and agents for Sonnet 4.5 pins and migrate to 5.5; trial mods for approval gates and status hooks.

bullets.title: Lofty launches MCP server for real-estate brokerages
bullets.summary: Lofty released an MCP server on 28 Sep so brokerages can connect their own AI agents and business systems to the Lofty AOS platform without custom code.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: real-estate/CRM MCP is a ready integration target for operator clients. Brand 9 Signs: possible lead feed from developer/brokerage contacts for community signage.

bullets.title: Restate raises $20M Series A for durable AI agent runtime
bullets.summary: Restate raised $20M to build durable-execution infrastructure so long-running agent workflows survive crashes and retries.
bullets.how: The Construct: durable execution is the missing piece for multi-step scheduled jobs that currently restart from scratch on failure. PRAGMA: reliability story for client deployments.

bullets.title: LlamaIndex Extract v2.5 improves schema-based document extraction
bullets.summary: LlamaIndex shipped Extract v2.5 with accuracy and grounding gains for schema-based extraction from documents.
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: candidate for pulling specs/quantities from RFPs, sign schedules and plan PDFs. PRAGMA: reusable intake-automation component.

bullets.title: Nvidia launches Open Agent Safety Platform with 100+ partners
bullets.summary: Nvidia's hardware-software stack is designed to quarantine rogue AI agents in milliseconds, built with 100+ industry partners.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: enterprise buyers will ask about agent containment; useful framing for consulting. The Construct: borrow the quarantine-by-default idea for permission scopes.

praxis_lesson: Reliability is becoming a product category alongside governance: durable runtimes (Restate) and containment (Nvidia) both treat agent failure as the default case. Design every Construct job to be resumable and fail-contained, not just permissioned.
